name: room
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate source raster pixel art for a game office room shell. Aspect 7:4 (420x240 logical pixels, enlarged source acceptable). Three-quarter slightly top-down cosy open-plan office, orthographic not isometric diamond. Crisp chunky square pixels, restrained 24-colour palette: ink #18232E #293B49, slate #425563 #657781 #95A3A8, cream #CCD0C6 #F0E5CE, warm wood #594A42 #80604B #B7835C #D8AB7C, teal #3D5B65 #5C8390. Flat opaque scene fills entire canvas, no external border. Top 36% is back wall, lower 64% empty light slate carpet with extremely subtle tile seams. Three evenly spaced large rectangular city windows across upper wall; sill height about 26% of image. A narrow horizontal glass strip under them across left two thirds. Far right small open dark lift shaft at wall/floor junction. Important: absolutely NO people, chairs, desks, kitchen counters, clocks, lamps or other foreground furniture; these come as separate sprites. No plants or rugs in floor area. Pixel-art architectural wall panels and wood trim only. Floor must remain completely clear. No text, logos, icons, badges, antialias, blur, gradients, painted texture. The room is a rectangular game background.
